messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's top with the garment shown in the reference images, matching its design, color, and details from both the front and back views. Preserve all other clothing items, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's top with the item shown in the reference images. Preserve the other clothing items, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands mostly still, briefly raising her right hand to her face and mouth before lowering it and turning her head slightly.","camera":"A static, eye-level full-body shot keeps the woman centered against the background.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless black top with a light floral pattern, loose light-gray wide-leg trousers with a side slit, and open-toed sandals.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a low bun at the nape of her neck.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a medium build and tanned skin stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a Ferris wheel on the left, a lit carousel structure on the right, a small kiosk behind her, and a paved open ground."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original brown/gold sleeveless top was replaced with a black sleeveless top featuring a light circular/floral pattern and lace trim, closely matching the reference garment. The light-gray wide-leg trousers, sandals, hair, body, pose, scene, and camera remained consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the woman's top with the reference garment, matching its design, color, and details from front and back, while preserving all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing aspects.
uncertain: The back view of the new top is not clearly visible in the output, so exact back-side detail match cannot be fully confirmed.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly darker/more contrasted than the source, possibly a minor color-grade change.
